Dear Xavier,

If I understand your question correctly, you have a couple of resources.  Within R if you load ggplot and use the command

?stat_smooth()

you will get a description of both the method and formula arguments.  Smoothers are typically the mean of x conditional on y.  You can use the formula argument to specify a specific formula (e.g. y ~ x) if you would prefer.  

Further information is also available at:

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/stat_smooth.html

I hope that his is of help.

Andrea
